title: Tsar Cannon
visualBrief: Complete individual Tsar Cannon display: long patinated bronze barrel with genuinely open deep bore and closed breech, thick ringed muzzle, cast bands, paired trunnions and side lifting lugs. Complete dark cast-metal carriage with both large open-spoked wheels, hubs/axle, paired stepped cheeks and crossmembers, rear trail and small support roller, plus an original faceted front casting and geometric scroll/rosette relief. Low stone platform and four separate displayed cannonballs on their small occupied contact bed. Original abstract geometry replaces portraits, arms, lion faces, inscriptions and plaque text. Surrounding trees, chains/bollards, paths, churches, palaces and all native buildings stay independent; no functioning weapon or navigable interior is asserted.
nativeAxes: +X north across the axle; +Z east along the barrel toward the muzzle and displayed balls; +Y up. Ordinary-picture approximation, not a surveyed bearing.
